title: Thread reply
description: A typed reply becomes part of a compact review thread without moving the composer.
useCase: Continue a contextual review while keeping the conversation and input connected.
interaction: Write a reply, send with Enter, then resolve or reopen the thread.
reducedMotion: Replies appear immediately; focus and conversation scrolling remain direct.
limitations: Local thread with three replies per preview; no messaging, persistence or server delivery.
look: Warm light-grey page with a white comment panel holding one comment with a brick-red initial avatar and a pale composer with an up-arrow send button.
motion: A clicked send appends the reply with a 200 ms ease-out fade and 5 px rise and jumps the log to the bottom; keyboard sends appear instantly.
adapt: `send` appends to `replies` and the effect pins `scroll` to the bottom; the entrance is the `reply-w2` keyframes on `.reply`, skipped by `usePreview` after keyboard input. Replace the seeded comment, names and three-reply cap with real thread data.
